important: This is a discovery and implementation specification, not a grant of rights. A seed URL or prior web inspection is not authorized corpus ingestion. Recheck current exact endpoints/terms.

families.title: Regulation S-X, S-K and Regulation G
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: part + dated section inventory; do not double count sections and whole parts
retrieval_steps: Resolve a documented as-of date and use the eCFR versioner full XML endpoint for Title 17 parts 210/229/244; inspect current API docs before using the existing template.
Persist original XML and HTTP receipt; enumerate actual sections and nested provisions, definitions, exceptions, tables and appendices.
Link amended regulations and Federal Register records; distinguish current-effective from historical-known-at-date research.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Official reuse and third-party incorporations still require screening; regulations are not a source license for private standards.
families.first_deliverable: Acquire and parse one complete declared part with exact locator and version tests, then expand.

families.title: Staff Accounting Bulletins and codification
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: bulletin and codified topic/version, linked not double counted
retrieval_steps: Discover every bulletin/topic from the official index; resolve current original publication and codified destination.
Download through the shared identifiable SEC gateway; retain facts/question/interpretive response/notes together.
Record issuance, amendment/rescission and applicability; replace the selected SAB99/108/14 references with reviewed actual source units.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Staff interpretation is not a Commission rule; do not silently treat rescinded text as current.
families.first_deliverable: Inventory all codified topics and retrieve scoped complete documents; test a rescission relationship.

families.title: Financial Reporting Manual
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: dated FRM section with explicit topic coverage
retrieval_steps: Follow current FRM topic and update links from the official landing page; build complete topic/section enumeration.
Acquire original HTML/downloads, retaining section labels, tables, exceptions, links and revision notes.
Separate revisions, aliases and former section identifiers; maintain non-authoritative staff label in retrieval/UI/export.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: A landing page link is not the manual; current HTML does not alone establish historical availability.
families.first_deliverable: Replace introduction/Topic1-only excerpt seed with a declared reviewed section collection.

families.title: Corporation Finance Interpretations / historical C&DIs
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Enumerate relevant S-X/S-K/non-GAAP/form/reporting interpretation categories through current official navigation.
Acquire each Q&A with question, complete answer, notes and last-change date; preserve historical C&DI aliases.
Map renumbered/withdrawn questions rather than assuming permanent numbering.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Current names/identifiers must be rechecked; staff interpretations are distinct from underlying rules.
families.first_deliverable: Acquire full selected non-GAAP collection and exact Q&A citations, then cover other categories.

families.title: Official filing forms and instructions
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Resolve the actual official form download from the form index, not guessed PDF filenames.
Prioritize 10-K/10-Q/8-K/S-1/S-3/S-4/20-F/6-K/F-1 and relevant amendment instructions.
Retain edition/date, instructions, items, appendices and page labels; compare tables to rendered PDFs before review.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: A blank form does not count as issuer practice or full text of an incorporated private standard.
families.first_deliverable: Acquire a complete form and general-instruction/item parser fixture; enumerate remaining editions.

families.title: EDGAR issuer filings and disclosure examples
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Declare a pilot issuer/form/period universe and resolve CIKs. Use documented submissions/older index files to enumerate accessions.
Resolve each official primary document and relevant exhibits from archive metadata; acquire actual HTML/PDF with amendment links.
Extract policy/footnote/MD&A/ICFR/earnings-release examples with context, tables and public availability.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Issuer-authored filings are not federal-authored works merely by submission; screen embedded third-party material and label practice, not authority.
families.first_deliverable: A source-screened pilot in revenue/non-GAAP/acquisition/ICFR with actual disclosure evidence.

families.title: SEC comment letters and issuer responses
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: numbered comment and linked correspondence thread
retrieval_steps: Discover UPLOAD and CORRESP accessions plus responses included in other filings using official EDGAR metadata.
Link original filing, numbered comment, issuer response, follow-up and revised disclosure; store uncertainty/missing links explicitly.
Preserve letter, filing, public-release and ingestion dates independently; curate a defined issue/company pilot.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Thread closure is not SEC approval; correspondence availability is not instantaneous.
families.first_deliverable: Complete and intentionally incomplete thread fixtures with cited gap indicators.

families.title: XBRL Company Facts and financial-statement/notes datasets
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Use documented Company Facts endpoints and official bulk dataset download links; record dataset release/vintage.
Preserve entity, contexts/dimensions, currency/units, scale/sign/decimals, period, taxonomy, custom tags and amendments.
Reconcile selected extracted records to original filing narratives/tables; do not assume Company Facts includes every custom/dimensional disclosure.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Structured facts are not a complete narrative corpus; keep original filings and dataset limitations.
families.first_deliverable: A reproducible pilot with fact-to-filing reconciliation and notes context.

families.title: OCA, disclosures guidance, AAER and reporting releases
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Navigate OCA independence/current staff publications and link underlying rules; enumerate a defined guidance period.
Follow AAER and release records to original complaints/orders/judgments and later dispositions; index document-level procedural state.
Acquire original allowed artifacts, parse exact locators, and require case-history and technical review.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: AAER list is not exhaustive; distinguish allegations, settlements, adjudicated findings and speeches/staff positions.
families.first_deliverable: Source-screened independence pilot and a small complete enforcement-history collection.

families.title: FASB ASC, ASUs, Concepts and implementation material
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Navigate official current pages for references, ASUs, concepts, agendas and taxonomies; detailed dynamic pages need verification.
Build independently maintained IDs/links/adoption metadata; draft FAF service-license request covering public paid AI use.
After specific clearance only, use approved feed/manual import with paragraph/exception/table/version preservation; keep licensed raw text outside public Git.
Build original explanations and examples from legitimately examined evidence while blocked; never reconstruct ASC through publisher mirrors.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Free reading does not license processing; ASU announcements/project summaries do not verify every current ASC criterion.
families.first_deliverable: Reference map for five core topics plus explicit rights request and disabled licensed adapter.

families.title: GASB standards and implementation Q&As
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Use official navigation to inventory statements, codification, implementation guides and transitions.
Obtain actual FAF/GASB permissions for intended text operations; use metadata and original teaching material before clearance.
Upon clearance preserve required/application material, paragraph IDs and entity-period applicability; government annual reports are a separately reviewed practice corpus.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: State/local accounting subject does not make GASB a federal government work.
families.first_deliverable: Governmental-accounting reference directory and scoped licensed-import fixtures.

families.title: PCAOB auditing, quality, ethics, inspections and enforcement
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Inventory actual current/archived AS, attestation, ethics/independence and quality standards via official indexes.
Use documented manual downloads or explicitly authorized feeds; do not enable a website crawler contrary to extraction terms.
Review Public Materials conditions, AI transmission and normalization/display obligations; preserve original notices and excluded third-party components.
Parse standard IDs, SEC approval/effective periods, public inspection findings and case dispositions.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Conditional publication reuse is separate from automated acquisition and model-training permission; do not seek nonpublic inspection material.
families.first_deliverable: Approved-route standard import and exact-version fixtures with reference-only fallback.

families.title: AU-C, AT-C, AR-C, ethics, quality and guides
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Navigate official standards/ASB resources for SAS/AU-C, SSAE/AT-C, SSARS/AR-C, ethics, quality management and guides.
Draft use-specific permission request; membership/personal access is not public-service AI authorization.
On clearance import approved feed/files with required/application/example distinctions, engagement regime, dates and exact locators.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Do not scrape member products or reuse credentials; user SOC reports are private inputs.
families.first_deliverable: Complete scoped reference inventory and original nonissuer decision aids, licensed fixture adapter only.

families.title: IASB/ISSB, IFRIC/SIC, SMEs and adoption
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover official issued standards, agenda decisions, examples/basis, SMEs, ISSB and taxonomy publications.
Prepare the licensing questionnaire/request with the actual free/paid service and AI processing scope; do not submit without authorization.
After clearance import appropriate editions, languages, effective/adoption rules, exceptions and locators; taxonomy license separate.
Author comparison matrices from independently verified criteria rather than copied third-party tables.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: ISSB, SMEs and local endorsed IFRS are distinct scopes; mere download availability is not a public AI license.
families.first_deliverable: Core reference map plus declared comparison scope and rights/adoption blockers.

Verify the actual rights owner for the edition; prepare an explicit public paid AI/RAG permission request rather than assuming IFAC grants everything.

families.title: GAO Yellow Book, Green Book and related guidance
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Follow current landing pages to official original editions, historical copies, errata and implementation guidance.
Check government authorship/reuse terms and third-party inclusions; download via permitted route retaining original bytes/notices.
Parse chapter/paragraph/table/page; distinguish engagement-type effective triggers and compare rendered tables.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Guidance/FAQs are not automatically equal to standards; keep Yellow versus Green purposes and versions clear.
families.first_deliverable: Full source-cleared editions with exact citation and visual extraction checks.

families.title: Federal Accounting Standards Advisory Board
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Enumerate official Handbook, standards/concepts, interpretations, technical bulletins/releases and amendments.
Verify each original publication notice/rights and download routes; preserve hierarchy and effective-date scope.
Parse actual paragraph/section locators and create original federal accounting examples with specialist review.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Federal FASAB framework is not GASB; verify work-specific rights and reused content.
families.first_deliverable: Handbook inventory and a complete scoped source import with exact locators.

families.title: OMB circulars, grants and Treasury reporting guidance
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: circular/supplement/manual edition, fiscal year and program
retrieval_steps: Resolve current official navigation to relevant A-123/A-136 circulars, annual Compliance Supplements and Treasury manuals.
Acquire regulations and circulars as distinct authority classes; preserve fiscal-year/program/appendix context and revisions.
Parse compliance matrices/schedules and reconcile tables; maintain old annual versions separately.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Do not collapse annual supplements or represent agency examples as universal GAAP.
families.first_deliverable: Documented pilot annual edition and version-aware compliance-table fixtures.

families.title: Federal statutes and regulations
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Use official bulk/API docs for securities/SOX/accounting-related law and relevant regulations.
Preserve statutory version, regulation effective dates, proposed/final distinction and amendments.
Screen privately incorporated material and keep exact section/subparagraph locators.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Official publication does not erase every embedded private copyright; proposals are not operative rules.
families.first_deliverable: Scoped authoritative-law corpus with amendments and applicability tests.

families.title: Official court opinions and procedural history
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover official opinions from court/govinfo sources for declared subject/jurisdiction/year scope.
Preserve docket, court, date, precedential designation where stated, pages and actual disposition; retrieve amended and later official records when available.
Write original case briefs with facts/arguments/holding/reasoning clearly separated from procedural records.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: No Westlaw/Lexis headnotes or proprietary citator data; no fee-incurring PACER retrieval without approval; do not claim exhaustive later history.
families.first_deliverable: Pilot with actual opinions and disclosed later-history gaps, expert reviewed.

families.title: State/local statutes, opinions and public reports
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Choose an explicit state/local pilot, identify its authentic legislature/court/regulator source and permissions.
Verify official government-edict versus other-agency/contractor content status; do not apply federal section105 universally.
Acquire only through permitted routes and retain jurisdiction/version/exact citations.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Government-adjacent content or issuer reports need separate rights assessment.
families.first_deliverable: Metadata map and reviewed source-specific route for one pilot.

families.title: COSO IC/ERM and thought papers
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover core frameworks and free downloads with exact applicable licensing terms.
Request software/public AI/paid-service permission; distinguish distributing an intact free download from embedding its contents in software.
Until cleared, create independent risk-control explanations and link references; no copied diagrams/framework prose.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Free downloads are not automatic software-use permission.
families.first_deliverable: Reference map and licensing packet plus original control examples.

families.title: IIA internal audit and ISACA/COBIT
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Inventory current and historical IIA standards/topical requirements and relevant COBIT/ISACA publications separately.
Review exact software and AI clauses. IIA published licensing materials require specific AI authorization and do not generally authorize public AI use.
Build metadata and independent internal-audit/ITGC examples; licensed ingestion only after explicit compatible permission.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: A generic software license does not establish AI authorization; do not infer performed audit work from documents.
families.first_deliverable: Permission-specific reference layers and original control-design cases.

families.title: NIST government IT/security/control guidance
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover official CSF, SP and AI risk guidance relevant to finance systems; check publication notices and external components.
Acquire permitted official formats, preserving version, control IDs, withdrawn/superseded status and tables.
Map guidance to original ITGC examples without calling NIST a GAAP/COSO requirement.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Government guidance scope and private incorporated material must be distinguished.
families.first_deliverable: One reviewed publication-to-control map with precise citations.

families.title: Big Four, other firms, textbooks and proprietary research
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover official metadata and source terms only through allowed routes; check embedded FAF/AICPA/COSO rights.
Prepare permission packets. Do not fetch restricted body text into AI, scrape user accounts, or use search/mirror/upload as a bypass.
Write genuine original teaching material, not mass paraphrases; licensed body adapters stay disabled until exact operation rights are established.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: No DART AI use absent appropriate separate permission; learning ideas is distinct from copying protected expression.
families.first_deliverable: Reference directory, blocked-source tests and per-product permission requests.

families.title: Open textbooks, academic articles and OER
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Discover works through official publishers, DOI metadata and institutional repositories; inspect actual full-text version and license.
Check CC0/BY/SA/NC/ND obligations and third-party figures per edition; NC is not automatically compatible with the paid Agent.
Acquire allowed text preserving chapter/page/attribution/modification notices, manuscript-vs-record version, corrections and retractions.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: DOI/abstract/search availability is not permission; empirical research/textbooks are not authoritative standards.
families.first_deliverable: A license-verified scoped collection, attribution/export tests and retraction handling.

families.title: Banking, tax, plan, utility and industry reporting
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Select specific regulator/industry pilots and resolve current official reporting instructions/APIs/downloads.
Check work authorship/private rights; NAIC material is not federal public domain. Separate tax law/instructions from GAAP.
Acquire permitted versions and structured reports with schedules, units, periods and historical amendments.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Specialist/jurisdiction scope and source rights must be explicit; no filing or tax-rate assumptions.
families.first_deliverable: One report-instruction pilot per approved industry, reviewed before production routing.

families.title: National standards, legal adoption and translations
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Choose one jurisdiction at a time and navigate official standard-setter/regulator/legislative sources.
Record local modifications, endorsement law, required date and language; inspect translation and narrative reuse rights.
Acquire only under compatible rights; use specialist-reviewed original comparisons while text is blocked.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: IFRS as issued is not always local-endorsed IFRS; machine translation is not authoritative local text.
families.first_deliverable: Explicit opt-in pilot with reference/rights/adoption matrix.

families.title: Our guides, cases, templates, questions and playbooks
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
families.unit_of_coverage: immutable content item/version and independently adjudicated question
retrieval_steps: Read each actual file, verify manifest hash and referenced sources, and record retain/revise/supersede disposition.
Author original source-supported scope/decision/case/template material; never copy exam banks or replace a publisher passage with synonyms.
Generate new immutable versions and content progress; require actual independent review for Agent admission.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: Public draft availability does not establish technical correctness or primary-text verification; contributors grant only rights held.
families.first_deliverable: Complete all63 item retrieval/review mapping, then deepen core topics.

families.title: User contracts, memos, workpapers and private reports
families.seed_status: discovery seeds; revalidate current paths and terms before acquisition
retrieval_steps: Accept only authorized files through authenticated MFA workspace; validate formats and quarantine before parsing.
Check publisher-specific restrictions even for user-provided files, and constrain model/provider retention.
Keep private source and derivatives isolated; citations resolve only within authorized workspace; delete derivatives on deletion.
families.rights_and_quality_limits: No public Git, cross-workspace retrieval, shared cache, training or public content ingestion; upload checkbox is not a blanket license.
families.first_deliverable: Secure private parsing-to-evidence flow with permission and deletion tests.
